title: HelpDesk Plus
problem_statement: IT teams struggle to manage employee support requests and technical issues efficiently. Current helpdesk solutions are often too complicated or don't meet the needs of modern IT teams. HelpDesk Plus will provide a better ticketing system that makes it easier for IT teams to manage requests and resolve issues more quickly.
target_users: IT support staff who handle employee requests daily
Employees throughout the company who need IT help
IT managers who oversee the helpdesk operation and team
user_stories: As an employee, I want to submit a support ticket easily so that I can get help with my technical issues quickly
As an IT technician, I want to manage and prioritize tickets efficiently so that I can resolve issues in a timely manner
As an IT manager, I want to see helpdesk performance metrics so that I can understand how the team is doing
As an employee, I want to track the status of my tickets so that I know when my issue will be resolved
acceptance_criteria: Employees should be able to submit tickets through a simple and clear form
IT staff should be able to view, assign, and update ticket status and details
The system should automatically send notifications when ticket status changes
Management should have access to basic reporting and analytics features

success_metrics.baseline: Current resolution time is longer than acceptable
success_metrics.target: Faster resolution times compared to before

success_metrics.metric: Employee satisfaction with IT support quality
success_metrics.target: Employees report being satisfied with IT support

success_metrics.metric: Total ticket volume handled by the team
success_metrics.target: Handle more tickets with the same team size

risks_open_questions: Competition from ServiceNow, Zendesk, and Jira Service Management is very strong
Integration with existing IT tools and systems will need careful planning
User adoption and change management will be important for success
out_of_scope: Advanced ITSM and ITIL process features
IT asset management and hardware tracking
Customer-facing or external support portal features
